annotation.walkthrough: The ellipsis runs the clue on into 58 across, making one picture of the comet. 'Shown up' sounds like revealed; it means arrived, as in 'has come'.
annotation.definitionFit: Halley's Comet crosses the sky every 75 or 76 years.

annotation.surface: Riding along the comet's glowing trail.
annotation.walkthrough: Continuing from 57 across, 'trail' seems to be the comet's tail; it is a scent trail, as followed by hounds.
annotation.definitionFit: Iridescent means showing shimmering, changing colours in the light.
